web-guide-idea-74.audience: New creators struggling to explain what they will offer.
web-guide-idea-74.offer: Help participants write a concrete first listing with a clear audience and session outline. The output is a draft they can refine and publish themselves.
web-guide-idea-74.steps.0: Ask each person to choose one idea.
web-guide-idea-74.steps.1: Write the title, audience promise and session steps.
web-guide-idea-74.steps.2: Exchange feedback and clarify what is included.
web-guide-idea-74.equipment: A phone and notes app are enough; a laptop is optional.
web-guide-idea-74.returnReason: Offer a later review after creators have tried their first sessions and learned from feedback.
web-guide-idea-74.promotion: Show a fictional vague description becoming a specific offer without promising bookings.

web-guide-idea-74.metadataDescription: Help new creators work on a clear service description, session outline and presentation. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
